rows.description: Amphenol FCI 10056847 right-angle 0.80 mm card-edge socket, 20 contacts, SMT (2 rows of 10, rows 8.20 mm apart)
rows.note: Drawing ELX-DG-010299-1 (10056847 rev G, 20 POS), PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10056847.pdf, sheet 2 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, CONNECTOR MOUNTING SIDE' (+ sheet 1 plan view for the housing). Printed: pitch 0.80 (9*0.80=7.20 per row), pad 0.50 x 2.00 (20-0.50 wide, 20-2.00 long), row centres 8.20 apart (4.10 each side of the peg line), 2 holes dia 1.55 +-0.05 on the peg line 9.60 apart (1.40 from the first pad of pins 1-10 to the peg: pin 1 = 1.40 right of the left peg), the two rows offset by 0.40 (pin 20 is 0.40 left of pin 1). Drawing orientation (mounting-side view): pins 1-10 in the lower row (pin 1 left), pins 11-20 in the upper row (pin 20 left, pin 11 right), the card opening faces the lower (board-edge) side. The footprint is the drawing turned 180 degrees about the peg-line centre so that the card entry faces up (-y): pins 1-10 in the upper row running right to left (pin 1 at x=+3.40, pin 10 at x=-3.80), pins 11-20 in the lower row running left to right (pin 11 at x=-3.40, pin 20 at x=+3.80); each row is 0.20 off the peg-line centre (rows 0.40 apart in x: 3.40-(-3.80)=7.20 centred at -0.20, and -3.40..3.80 centred at +0.20) - encoded with a gap of 0.40 after 'pad 0' (shifts the whole side by 0.20). Origin: centre of the housing and of the peg line (housing 11.00 wide x 7.80 deep from sheet 1: plan width 11.00, side-view depth 7.80; pegs/holes at x=+-4.80 = 9.60/2, y=0 on the housing centre line, read from the plan view). Peg holes dia 1.55 are drawn as non-plated (the print does not say plated). Note: 'pins' in this print are 1..20 (rows 1-10 and 11-20).

rows.description: PCI Express x16 card-edge socket, 1.00 mm pitch, vertical SMT, 164 contacts (A1-A82, B1-B82), Amphenol FCI Gen 4/5 vertical SMT
rows.note: No land pattern in the own PDF (datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/ssio_pcie_gen4_gen5.pdf is a catalog; it says the connector is footprint compatible with PCIe Gen 1/2/3). Land pattern taken from the sibling drawing 10165968 rev A 'PCI Express Gen 6, SMT Type' (PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10165968c.pdf, sheet 3 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT, PAD TYPE', 164 POSITION row of the table), assumed identical for the Gen 4/5 vertical SMT (catalog: 'footprint compatible with PCIe 3/2/1'). Printed: pitch 1.00, pad width 0.53 +-0.05, pad length 2.00 +-0.05, pad row centres 3.60 either side of the centre line (row A top, row B bottom, as seen from the top of the board with #A1/#B1 at the left), A1..A11 = 10 spaces at 1.00 (10.00), A12..A82 = DIM J = 70.00 (70 spaces), key: A11 to A12 = 3.00 (hole axis 1.65 right of A11 and 1.35 left of A12), so a gap of 3.00-1.00 = 2.00 after pad 11; A1 to A82 = 10+3+70 = 83.00; locating hole dia 1.2 +-0.05 on the centre line at A11+1.65 (axis of datum Z); tabs: rectangle 3.00 x 5.00 (2X 3.00 +-0.05, 2X 5.00 +-0.05) 1.50 beyond the end pad on each end (DIM H = 92.00 for 164 = 83.00 + 2*(1.50+3.00): the left tab spans A1-4.50..A1-1.50, the right A82+1.50..A82+4.50, centres at +-3.00 from the end pads); right tab has a dia 1.80 +-0.05 hole whose centre is 0.30 inside the tab's inner edge (DIM K = 73.15 from the key hole to that centre: 11.65+73.15 = 84.80 = 84.50+0.30). The two 3.00 x 5.00 rectangles are NOT drawn as pads: the print does not name them (hold-down solder pad or keep-out is unknown) and the right one is cut by the dia 1.80 hole (a pad and a hole would overlap, which the footprint loader refuses); the dia 1.80 and dia 1.20 holes are drawn non-plated (the print does not say plated). Origin: x centre of the 83.00 pad span (the layout is symmetric about it: tabs 1.50 beyond each end pad), y the centre line between the two pad rows; body: 89.00 long (DIM B for 164 in sibling drawing 10173133 sheet 1 table) x 5.80 wide (housing width in 10165968 sheet 1), centred.

rows.description: Amphenol Cool Edge 1.00 mm PCIe card-edge socket, vertical SMT, {N} contacts (A/B rows)
rows.note: No land pattern in the own PDF (ssio_cooledge_1_00mm.pdf is a catalog). Land pattern taken from the sibling drawing 10177636 rev 3 'PCIe COOL EDGE 6.0, SMT VERTICAL, ASSEMBLY - LATCH' (PRELIMINARY; PDF datasheets/connector-card-edge/amphenol/10177636.pdf, sheet 2 'RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT', 164 pins; the Cool Edge catalog lists CEE0 + 098/164/230 pins, so the same layout is assumed for the latch-less parts). Only the 164-pin layout is printed; 98 and 230 are the same pattern with A/B rows shortened/lengthened (the key between A11 and A12 is fixed in the PCIe CEM; N/2 pads per row), NOT printed. Printed (164): pitch 1.00 (PITCH), pad width 0.55 +-0.03, pad length 1.20 +-0.05 (outer-to-outer 6.00 +-0.05, inner-to-inner 3.60 +-0.05: (6.00-3.60)/2 = 1.20; row centres = +-(3.60/2+1.20/2) = +-2.40), A1..A11 10 spaces, A11 to A12 = 3.00 read from the drawing scale (the CEM key; a gap of 2.00 after pad 11), A1 to A82 = 83.00 (hole-to-hole 87.00 = 83.00 + 2*2.00), holes: dia 1.95 +-0.05 left at A1-2.00 and dia 1.65 +-0.05 right at A82+2.00, both 1.50 below the centre line (toward the B row); tabs 2.90 x 3.80 (2X 2.90 +-0.05, 2X 3.80 +-0.05) centred on the centre line, whose inner edge is 1.55 +-0.05 beyond the hole axis (so centre at the end pad -+5.00: A1-2.00-1.55-1.45 = A1-5.00, A82+2.00+1.55+1.45 = A82+5.00). Row A is the top row of the layout (A1 top left), B below. The 2.90 x 3.80 rectangles are not named (taken as hold-down solder pads, pin 0); holes drawn non-plated (the print does not say plated). Origin: x centre of the A1..A82 pad span (layout symmetric: holes +-2.00 beyond the end pads), y the centre line between the rows. Body: housing length 95.00 for 164 (sheet 1 overall 95.00, catalog: 'length 95mm, width 5.80') = N/2+13 (98: 62, 230: 128, extrapolated) x 5.80.
